mintAuthority.summary: USDRIF has one native issuance deployment on Rootstock. The RIF and DOC V3 collateral buckets are the only verified MINTER_ROLE members and mint through overcollateralized RIF On Chain accounting; MOC token-vote governance can authorize mint-parameter, role, or UUPS changes, so the native posture remains partially-bounded-admin and raiseable. The Arbitrum LayerZero OFT and the Rootstock adapter are bridge machinery assessed only in Bridge Risk; their message-path mint/burn, lockbox, peer, delegate, and owner controls do not expand native Mint Authority.

controls.capDescription: The bucket can mint USDRIF only through its collateralized operation path, bounded by deposited RIF, coverage thresholds, oracle pricing, and shared multi-collateral rules.
controls.evidence: At Rootstock block 9157327 on 2026-08-16, getRoleMemberCount(MINTER_ROLE) and BURNER_ROLE enumeration on the USDRIF token reported this official V3 MocCore bucket as one of exactly two members. Current RIF bucket collateral was 306,803,933.9926229 RIF; its protocol coverage and collateralized operation path bound user-initiated minting, while governance can change parameters or logic.

controls.label: RIF On Chain MOC token-vote governance
controls.capDescription: Accepted MOC-holder proposals can authorize changer contracts that alter mint parameters, roles, or UUPS implementations; no immutable numeric supply ceiling applies.
controls.evidence: At Rootstock block 9157327, the current governance path still resolves Governor 0x3b8853... to VotingMachine 0x65a568..., while VotingMachine names that Governor as its controlled governor. MOC stakers submit pre-votes and token-weighted votes through VotingMachine; accepted proposals call the controlled Governor, which authorizes the proposal's changer contract. Registry reads at block 9077990 report a 100,000 MOC proposal stake, 5% pre-vote winner threshold, 20% quorum, 50% acceptance threshold, 30% veto threshold, and a seven-day ordinary voting period; the contract also permits early acceptance at its configured high-support threshold, so no hard seven-day execution delay is claimed. The verified VotingMachine source executes an accepted proposal by calling controlledGovernor.executeChange; these governance parameters constrain proposals that can authorize mint changes or upgrades.

review.evidence: Current Rootstock block 9157327 reads enumerate the two and only two direct USDRIF MINTER_ROLE and BURNER_ROLE members: the RIF and DOC V3 collateral buckets. Their operation paths mint exclusively against protocol-accounted collateral, so native supply reconciliation is continuous by construction. The same block resolves the native UUPS implementation and Governor. The recursive governance chain remains: Governor 0x3b8853... is owned by VotingMachine 0x65a568..., Governor and VotingMachine proxies share ProxyAdmin 0x1a1824..., ProxyAdmin owner() is UpgradeDelegator proxy 0x131564..., and verified UpgradeDelegator implementation 0x6d1cca... gates upgrade(), upgradeAndCall(), and changeProxyAdmin() through Governor.isAuthorizedChanger with no keyholder bypass. Arbitrum OFT mint/burn and Rootstock adapter/OFT-owner administration are bridge controls retained under Bridge Risk and do not enter this native inventory. Native issuance remains partially-bounded-admin, raiseable, continuously reconciled, and unsupervised.
